subtitle.zh: 从音乐叙事到游戏世界的视觉延伸
subtitle.en: From music narrative to an extended game world

description.zh: 为邓泽西的 MV 参与前期概念、场景与分镜设计，并将视觉世界延伸至宣传小游戏。
description.en: Contributing concept, environment, and storyboard design to Deng Zexi’s music video, with a visual extension into a promotional mini-game.

coverAlt.zh: 蘑菇森林构成的游戏开始画面，中央显示毒蘑菇标题。
coverAlt.en: A mushroom forest forms the game start screen, with the title at its centre.

role.zh: 前期概念、场景与分镜；宣传小游戏玩法与视觉资产；参与调色与视觉统一
role.en: Early concept, environments, and storyboards; promotional mini-game gameplay and assets; contribution to grading and visual consistency

stage.zh: MV 已发布；本页展示个人参与部分
stage.en: Music video released; this case documents my contributions

deliverables.zh: 概念方案、叙事分镜、游戏界面与视觉资产
deliverables.en: Concept direction, narrative storyboards, game interface, and visual assets

overview.zh: 邓泽西的官方 MV，以一位职场女性进入奇幻游戏世界并成为蘑菇女巫为线索。我参与前期整体概念、场景与分镜设计，并设计用于宣传的小游戏玩法与视觉资产。
overview.en: Deng Zexi’s official music video follows an office worker into a fantasy game world, where she becomes a mushroom witch. I contributed the early concept, environments, and storyboards, and designed gameplay and visual assets for a promotional mini-game.

paragraphs.zh: 用“进入游戏”连接现实职场与奇幻世界，让音乐中的态度通过角色、空间与情节得到表达。经典绘画的视觉引用，成为画面构成与情绪的素材。
paragraphs.en: Entering a game connects office life with a fantasy world, allowing the music’s attitude to emerge through characters, spaces, and events. References to classical paintings inform composition and mood.

text.zh: 以进入、探索、对抗与返回组织影像，而不是只串联独立画面。
text.en: Entry, exploration, confrontation, and return organise the film as a connected journey.

text.zh: 在绘画参考、数字绘制与场景设计之间建立一致的视觉语言。
text.en: Build a consistent language across painting references, digital artwork, and environments.

text.zh: 让观众在小游戏中继续接触 MV 的角色与世界。
text.en: Let audiences encounter the video’s characters and world through a mini-game.

paragraphs.zh: 叙事由扭曲的职场开始，经过进入世界、森林探索与规则冲突，再到女巫觉醒、对话反击、掌控世界与返回现实。分镜把这些转折落实到镜头、人物与空间关系。
paragraphs.en: The story moves from a distorted office into a new world, forest exploration, and conflict with its rules, followed by the witch’s awakening, rebuttal, control, and return. Storyboards translate these changes into shots and relationships between figures and spaces.

alt.zh: 毒蘑菇项目的叙事分镜与概念画面。
alt.en: A storyboard and concept frame from Poisonous Mushrooms.

caption.zh: 前期视觉材料：探索场景构成与角色在空间中的关系。
caption.en: Early visual material exploring composition and the character’s place in the environment.

alt.zh: 已发布 MV 中的蘑菇森林画面。
alt.en: The mushroom forest in the released music video.

caption.zh: 已发布 MV 画面：从前期叙事与概念走向协作完成的影像。
caption.en: Released MV frame: early narrative and concepts become a collaboratively produced film.

paragraphs.zh: 宣传小游戏沿用 MV 的蘑菇森林世界，包含开始画面与角色选择等视觉资产。玩法设计与界面视觉相互配合，让影像中的世界进入可参与的情境。
paragraphs.en: The promotional mini-game carries over the mushroom forest world, with assets including a start screen and character selection. Gameplay and interface visuals extend the film into a participatory setting.

alt.zh: 毒蘑菇小游戏开始界面。
alt.en: The start screen of the Poisonous Mushrooms mini-game.

caption.zh: 开始界面：沿用世界观，同时提供直接的参与入口。
caption.en: Start screen: keeping the world’s visual language with a direct entry point.

alt.zh: 四个蘑菇角色的选择界面。
alt.en: A selection interface with mushroom characters.

caption.zh: 角色选择：将叙事角色转化为界面中的可选择对象。
caption.en: Character selection transforms narrative figures into choices within the interface.

paragraphs.zh: 前期使用数字绘画与 AI 辅助探索构图，结合 Photoshop、Procreate 的修整与细化，将不同来源的视觉素材统一到项目语言中。后期参与调色与视觉一致性的调整。
paragraphs.en: Early digital painting and AI-assisted composition exploration were refined in Photoshop and Procreate to bring different visual sources into one language. I also contributed to grading and visual consistency.

paragraphs.zh: MV 是协作成果。本案例重点展示我的概念、分镜与小游戏工作，完整制作信息以公开视频的署名为准。
paragraphs.en: The music video is a collaborative outcome. This case focuses on my concept, storyboard, and mini-game work; full production credits are provided with the published video.

paragraphs.zh: 影像已公开发布，概念与视觉资产也形成了从 MV 到小游戏的延伸。现有材料不足以把播放量或传播效果归因于个人设计，因此这里以可展示的产出说明贡献。
paragraphs.en: The video has been publicly released, with concepts and assets extending into a mini-game. The available evidence does not attribute audience reach to individual design decisions, so the case demonstrates contributions through tangible outputs.

paragraphs.zh: 这次实践让我关注：视觉统一需要在前期建立规则，也需要在跨媒介制作中持续维护；界面与影像虽然观看方式不同，仍可以共享角色、色彩与叙事线索。
paragraphs.en: This work highlights the need to establish visual rules early and maintain them across media. Interfaces and films have different viewing patterns, but can share characters, colour, and narrative cues.
